newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 27.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* U.S. financial markets were closed on Monday for the Memorial Day observance.
* On Monday, the benchmark Kuala Lumpur Composite Index rose 2.99 points up to 1,081.19, while the small-capitalised Second Board index gained 0.46 of a point to 566.17.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5015/25 a dollar at around 1000 GMT on Monday.
* Timber stocks were in play again, as retail investors speculated on the sector. New Straits Times says North Borneo Timber and Construction and Supplies House Bhd rumoured to be in merger.
* Such retail-sponsored trading may continue, dealers said. "It will be mainly speculators and bargain-hunters" in the market, said an institutional dealer with a local firm.
* Analysts say a lack of any substantive news will likely keep other investors sidelined.
